rca of the issue: Missing /my-requests route in App.js caused navigate('/my-requests') from ActionButtons.js internal-request submit to fall through to the consumer catch-all (Navigate to /home). RCA: ActionButtons.js line 57 calls navigate('/my-requests') and MyRequests component is imported at App.js:24, but the corresponding <Route> was never added inside the consumer layout block (lines 83-93). Reproduction: as active consumer, open /establishment/:id, click any active internal button, fill and submit the form -> observed URL change to /home instead of /my-requests. Fix: added <Route path='/my-requests' element={<MyRequests />} /> inside the RoleRoute role='consumer' block. Re-tested and redirect now lands on /my-requests, list renders with c-req-* cards, cancel works.
